facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 02/02/2026 records Tunisia as having signed the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention) on 23/04/2019, with no date of ratification or accession and no date of deposit; 20 of 55 states have ratified or acceded.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

systems.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

note: Only Council of Europe Convention 108 is named, which is not an African text.
A workshop on domestication and a gap analysis are not a signature, ratification or national law; the document says none of these for Tunisia.
The AfCFTA digital trade protocol is only a strategy axis; no signature or ratification stated.
